arStrings.szText: The four lesser evils {c_highlight}Azmodan{/c}, {c_highlight}Duriel{/c}, {c_highlight}Belial{/c}, and {c_highlight}Andariel{/c} have invaded Sanctuary. Defeat them to uncover {c_highlight}Corrupted Essences{/c}.
Slay them and return their {c_highlight}Corrupted Essences{/c} to {c_highlight}Hadriel{/c} to uncover {c_highlight}Divine Gifts{/c}.
Return to {c_highlight}Hadriel{/c} at any time from a divine portal in each {icon:Icon_Tooltip_Marker_CapitalWaypointActive,1.8} {c_highlight}Capital City{/c}.
Find the {c_highlight}Lesser Evils{/c} on your {hotkey:map} {c_highlight}World Map{/c} and hunt them down.
Use {hotkey:Season} {c_highlight}Season Ranks{/c} to earn {c_highlight}additional rewards{/c} and discover what to do next!
